content.text: Grep apparently failed; the field is likely "photo".
The bug is in `UsersService.update`: line 226 checks `photo === undefined` where it should check `=== null`.

candidates.explanation: The photo branch is `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }`. When the profile edit omits `photo`, which is the case when only the first name changes, `photo` is set to null. The repository then merges `{...existing, ...payload}`, so `photo: null` overwrites the stored avatar and the picture disappears. Uploading again sets it back until the next edit that omits `photo`. The create method has the correct form, `photo === null`. The condition should be `=== null`, so an omitted photo stays `undefined` and the existing value is kept. Only an explicit null should clear it.

fix.description: Change the condition on line 226 from `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` to `updateUserDto.photo === null`. An omitted photo then stays undefined and the repository keeps the existing value. Only an explicit null clears it.
